title: The Reckoning-Works - busy clockwork (C2, before the Paul story)
_note: The over-productive engine hall on the Rimeway Fold. Comic, never menacing: D Mixolydian, 138 BPM, 16 bars A-A'-B-A. A staccato pulse12 'counting' lead with rests between every figure (the clerks never finish a thought); a PLUCK ostinato in relentless eighths (the card-belt); tri_bass oom-pah; woodblock-clock hats on every eighth; the output board's BELL dings at every phrase end. B (bars 9-12) is the board climbing: sixteenth-note turns stepping down, then a straight eighth-note scale up an octave. Bar 16 cadences C->D back into bar 1. snes era for the bell, 6 voices peak.
